# Exporting the spatial files

The spatial files are originally in a shape format. Here I combine them into a single geopackage with five layers.

```{r}
library(sf)
# Destination
gpkg <- "data/spatialData.gpkg"
```


```{r}
#| eval: false
library(purrr)

# Find all shapefiles
shp_files <- list.files(
  "data",
  pattern = "\\.shp$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)


# Remove existing file if necessary
if (file.exists(gpkg)) file.remove(gpkg)

# Write each shapefile as a separate layer
walk(shp_files, \(file) {
  layer_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))

  st_read(file, quiet = TRUE) |>
    st_write(
      gpkg,
      layer = layer_name,
      append = FALSE,
      quiet = TRUE
    )
})
```


```{r}
st_layers(gpkg)
```
